incidents.text: It's a yellow card for Romelu Lukaku (Belgium). Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) is penalised for a foul. Dario Herrera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
Saeid Ezatolahi (Iran) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
Amir Ghalenoei has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) comes on the pitch for Saleh Hardani.
The game has come to an end for Thomas Meunier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Timothy Castagne (Belgium).
Rudi Garcia has decided to substitute Nicolas Raskin and he is replaced by Hans Vanaken (Belgium).
Rudi Garcia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dodi Lukebakio (Belgium) replacing Alexis Saelemaekers.
Substitution. Ehsan Hajsafi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Milad Mohammadi (Iran).
Amir Ghalenoei prepares a substitution. Mohammad Mohebi is replaced by Mehdi Torabi (Iran).
Dario Herrera shows a red card with no hesitation. Nathan Ngoy (Belgium) can have an early bath and think about his challenge.
The substitution is prepared. Arthur Theate (Belgium) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romelu Lukaku.
Substitution. Saman Ghoddos will be replaced by Shahriyar Moghanlou (Iran).
Here is a change. Saeid Ezatolahi is going off and Amir Ghalenoei gives the last tactical orders to Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh (Iran).
The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kevin De Bruyne walks off the pitch to be replaced by Matias Fernandez-Pardo (Belgium).
